Unsafe attribute wrappers assert programmer safety obligations, not compiler proof or permission for undefined behavior. Do not execute symbol collisions or invalid memory placement as differential oracles, or require general unsafe UB to be statically rejected.

Attribute syntax acceptance does not establish C calling conventions, target/platform ABI interoperability, external declarations, object retention, export names or section placement. Missing artifact workflows must inspect actual intermediate objects or libraries and link outputs as appropriate, with source and artifact identities bound to outcomes.

used guarantees intermediate object retention, excluding final binaries, and the linker remains free to remove it. Duplicate used has only its first effect with a lint; link_section and export_name duplicates currently warn for future compatibility rather than imposing a hard rejection.
This page gives no separate no_mangle syntax or duplicate rule. Do not invent one or infer precedence between different attributes from within-attribute first-use rules.

Static source and row validation only is supplied. Native CHECK/BUILD, defined runs, pinned-stock comparisons, workers1/8, artifact inspection, current evidence import and framework integration remain absent and owned by the integrating workflow.
